body.text: Paper-lantern workshop. Only people aged 14 through 65, inclusive, may attend. Someone who is neither a resident nor a student is excluded unless they are a member. A person under 18 is excluded if they lack guardian consent; this youth exclusion alone does not apply when the person is both a resident and a scholarship recipient. A scholarship does not waive the age range or the resident/student/member requirement. Registration must be submitted strictly before 2031-11-02T01:30:00.000Z; the exact stated instant is too late. All prices are in USD and apply only after admission. Charge the first applicable price in this order: scholarship recipient, $0; member, $17; otherwise, $48. Prices do not stack. There are no other eligibility conditions or deadlines.
